title: Shopping on Saturday
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Saturday. She needs milk, bread and six apples. The shop is near her house, so she walks there.

At the till, Anna pays with a ten-dollar note. The woman gives her two dollars back. Her bag is heavy, so she takes a taxi home.

questions.text: What does Anna need to buy?
How much money does the woman give Anna back?
Where does Anna most likely live?
Why does Anna probably not walk home?

vocabulary.definition: the place in a shop where you pay

paragraph_translations: Anna idzie do sklepu w sobotę. Potrzebuje mleka, chleba i sześciu jabłek. Sklep jest blisko jej domu, więc idzie tam pieszo.
Przy kasie Anna płaci banknotem dziesięciodolarowym. Kobieta oddaje jej dwa dolary. Jej torba jest ciężka, więc wraca do domu taksówką.
